presets.label: YouTube thumbnail
presets.note: 16:9, JPG or PNG. The YouTube app takes up to 2 MB, a computer up to 50 MB. For the recommended 3840 × 2160, export at 3x.

guides.label: Watch progress
guides.note: Shown on videos a viewer has started

sources.title: YouTube Help: Add video thumbnails
sources.confirms: 16:9; JPG or PNG; 3840 × 2160 recommended, 640 px minimum width; 2 MB from mobile, 50 MB from desktop

presets.label: YouTube Shorts
presets.note: 9:16. The player covers the edges with the title, channel and buttons, so keep text in the safe zone. For a Shorts thumbnail, export at 2x (2160 × 3840 recommended).

guides.label: Covered by YouTube UI
guides.note: Like, comment, share and remix buttons

guides.label: Covered by YouTube UI
guides.note: Title, channel name, subscribe and sound

sources.title: YouTube Help: Add video thumbnails
sources.confirms: Shorts thumbnails 9:16, 2160 × 3840 recommended, 640 px minimum height

sources.title: Google Ads Help: About video ad specs (universal safe zones)
sources.confirms: Vertical 1080 × 1920 safe zone: 288 px top, 672 px bottom, 48 px left, 192 px right (from Google's safe zone diagram)

sources.title: Google Ads Help: Use square and vertical video
sources.confirms: Keep logos, products and text inside the safe zone so overlays and buttons do not cover them

presets.label: YouTube channel banner
presets.note: One image for every screen: TV shows all of it, desktop a wide strip, phones the centre. Keep text and logos inside the all-devices area. At least 2048 × 1152, 6 MB or smaller.

guides.label: All devices
guides.note: Text and logos: 1235 × 338 at 2048 × 1152, about 1546 × 423 here

sources.title: YouTube Help: Manage your channel branding
sources.confirms: Minimum 2048 × 1152 (16:9); 2560 × 1440 recommended; text and logo safe area 1235 × 338 at the minimum size; 6 MB or smaller; cropped on some devices

presets.label: YouTube profile picture
presets.note: Shown as a circle, as small as 98 px, so keep it bold and centred. JPG, PNG, GIF or BMP up to 15 MB. 800 × 800 is recommended.
presets.keywords: profile picture avatar icon logo pfp

sources.title: YouTube Help: Manage your channel branding
sources.confirms: JPG, GIF, BMP or PNG (no animated GIF); up to 15 MB; renders at 98 × 98

presets.label: YouTube post image
presets.note: The feed shows post images square. JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP up to 16 MB. YouTube gives no pixel size, so 1080 × 1080 is recommended.

sources.title: YouTube Help: Create posts
sources.confirms: Up to 16 MB; JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP; 1:1 suggested because the feed shows images square; up to 10 images per post

presets.label: YouTube video watermark
presets.note: Square, at least 150 × 150, under 1 MB. It sits small over your videos, so a simple mark on a clear background reads best.

sources.title: YouTube Help: Manage your channel branding
sources.confirms: Video watermark: square, minimum 150 × 150, less than 1 MB

presets.label: Spotify podcast cover
presets.note: Square. Spotify suggests 1400 to 3000 px, JPG or PNG. It shows tiny in lists, so keep the title big.

sources.title: Spotify for Creators: The dos and don'ts of show art
sources.confirms: Square 1:1, between 1400 × 1400 and 3000 × 3000 (article dated 2019)

sources.title: Spotify: Podcast Delivery Specification v1.10
sources.confirms: Episode and show artwork 1:1 in high resolution; no pixel or file size limit stated

sources.title: Spotify Help: Uploading cover art
sources.confirms: How to upload; no size or format limits stated

presets.label: Spotify video thumbnail
presets.note: 16:9 landscape is required; 1920 × 1080 is suggested. Shown for video episodes in the Spotify mobile app.

sources.title: Spotify Help: Thumbnails
sources.confirms: Horizontal, 16:9 required; 1920 × 1080 suggested; shown only for video episodes in the mobile app

presets.label: Spotify playlist cover
presets.note: Square JPG. Spotify's help gives no pixel size; staying under 4 MB is the widely reported limit.

sources.title: Spotify Help: Customize your playlist cover
sources.confirms: How to add a cover; no size or format limits stated

sources.title: Spotify for Developers: Add custom playlist cover image
sources.confirms: JPEG only (API uploads are capped at 256 KB of Base64 data)

sources.title: Spotify Community: My playlist photo
sources.confirms: Moderator answer: JPEG, up to 4 MB (not on the current help page)

presets.label: Spotify artist header
presets.note: At least 2660 × 1140; JPG, PNG or GIF up to 20 MB. Shown on desktop, web and TV with your name over the lower left. Spotify asks for no text in artist images.
presets.keywords: artist banner header spotify for artists

guides.label: Safe area (approx.)
guides.note: The header crops to the window; keep faces near the upper middle

guides.label: Covered by artist name
guides.note: Approximate; the name and listener count sit here on desktop

sources.title: Spotify for Artists: Artist image guidelines
sources.confirms: Header at least 2660 × 1140; JPEG, PNG or GIF; up to 20 MB; no text, advertising or busy backgrounds

sources.title: Spotify for Artists: Managing your artist images on Spotify
sources.confirms: The header shows on desktop, web player and smart TVs

presets.label: Spotify artist profile picture
presets.note: At least 750 × 750; JPG, PNG or GIF up to 20 MB. Shown as a circle in the mobile app and in search.
presets.keywords: artist avatar profile picture pfp spotify for artists

sources.title: Spotify for Artists: Artist image guidelines
sources.confirms: Avatar at least 750 × 750; JPEG, PNG or GIF; up to 20 MB

sources.title: Spotify for Artists: Managing your artist images on Spotify
sources.confirms: The avatar shows at the top of the mobile profile and next to your name in search

presets.label: Spotify album cover
presets.note: Square, 640 to 10,000 px, sRGB. Spotify asks for PNG or lossless JPG without an embedded colour profile. Uploads go through your distributor.
presets.keywords: single ep release artwork music cover

sources.title: Spotify for Artists: Cover art requirements
sources.confirms: TIFF, PNG or JPG with lossless encoding; 640 to 10,000 px; 1:1; sRGB, 24 bits per pixel; no embedded profiles or orientation metadata

presets.label: Story
presets.note: 9:16 for stories, Reels and Shorts covers. Keep text away from the top and bottom edges.

presets.label: Wide
presets.note: 16:9 full HD for video frames, slides and end screens.
